name: HR_V3000 vocoder mode words
desc: ECMODE and DCMODE, sent over UART as control packets 0x05 / 0x06. Not memory-mapped: the addresses here are only an ordering; wire_addr is the command code.

registers.name: ECMODE
registers.desc: Encoder mode word, command 0x05, parameter length 2 (frame Length 3, ACK Length 1). Manual examples: 0x1840 (4.2.1, p.13: tone detect + DTX + NS), 0x1040 (5.1.2, p.14: DTX off), 0x1000 (5.2.2, p.15: NS off as well), 0x4000 (5.3.2, p.16: DTMF send), 0x3840 (5.4.2, p.17: AGC on). Same field ID as DVSI PKT_ECMODE.
registers.ds_ref: HR_V3000 manual v1.2, 4.2.1 command table p.12; 5 ECMODE table p.13-14; A.1 p.22

fields.ds_ref: HR_V3000 manual v1.2, 5 ECMODE table, p.13

fields.name: NS_ENABLE
fields.desc: 1 = background noise suppression on speech and silence frames (not on tone/DTMF frames); takes a few seconds to take effect after being set. DVSI name NS_ENABLE.
fields.ds_ref: HR_V3000 manual v1.2, 5 ECMODE table p.13; 5.2.1-5.2.2 p.15 (default 1)
HR_V3000 manual v1.2, 5 ECMODE table, p.13

fields.name: DTX_ENABLE
fields.desc: 1 = discontinuous transmission: during speech gaps the encoder emits a standard silence frame, which a receiving decoder replaces with comfort noise. DVSI name DTX_ENABLE.
fields.ds_ref: HR_V3000 manual v1.2, 5 ECMODE table p.13; 5.1.1-5.1.2 p.14 (default 1)

fields.name: TONE_DET_ENABLE
fields.desc: 1 = single- and dual-tone detection on. Set in every manual example except the DTMF-send one. Default not stated. DVSI name TD_ENABLE.
fields.ds_ref: HR_V3000 manual v1.2, 5 ECMODE table, p.13

fields.name: AGC_ON
fields.desc: 1 = input AGC on: aims at SET_DBM0_LEVEL (0xab, default -22 dBm0) within MIN_DB_GAIN (0xad, default -10 dB) .. MAX_DB_GAIN (0xac, default 20 dB). Default not stated. DIFFERS FROM DVSI: bit 13 there is EC_ENABLE, the echo canceller.
fields.ds_ref: HR_V3000 manual v1.2, 5 ECMODE table p.13; 5.4.1-5.4.2 p.16-17

fields.name: DTMF_SEND
fields.desc: 1 = the encoder ignores speech and encodes the tone selected by ENC_TONE_INDEX (0xae) at ENC_TONE_LEVEL (0xaf). Must be 0 for normal speech. DVSI name TS_ENABLE (tone send). Default not stated.
fields.ds_ref: HR_V3000 manual v1.2, 5 ECMODE table p.13; 5.3.1-5.3.2 p.15-16
HR_V3000 manual v1.2, 5 ECMODE table, p.13

registers.name: DCMODE
registers.desc: Decoder mode word, command 0x06, parameter length 2 (frame Length 3, ACK Length 1). Manual examples: 0x0008 (5.1.2, p.14: continuous comfort noise), 0x4000 (5.3.2, p.16: play a tone). Same field ID as DVSI PKT_DCMODE.
registers.ds_ref: HR_V3000 manual v1.2, 4.2.1 command table p.12; 5 DCMODE table p.14; A.1 p.22

fields.desc: Reserved, write 0. DVSI uses bit 2 (LOST_FRAME) here.
fields.ds_ref: HR_V3000 manual v1.2, 5 DCMODE table, p.14

fields.name: CNI_FRAME
fields.desc: 1 = the decoder outputs comfort noise continuously. Off by default because with it on the decoder never stops producing noise. DVSI name CNI_FRAME.
fields.ds_ref: HR_V3000 manual v1.2, 5 DCMODE table p.14; 5.1.1-5.1.2 p.14 (default 0)

fields.desc: Reserved, write 0. DVSI uses bits 7-8 (CP_SELECT, CP_ENABLE) here.
fields.ds_ref: HR_V3000 manual v1.2, 5 DCMODE table, p.14

fields.name: DTMF_SEND
fields.desc: 1 = the decoder ignores coded input and plays the tone selected by DEC_TONE_INDEX (0xb0) at DEC_TONE_LEVEL (0xb1). Must be 0 for normal decoding. DVSI name TS_ENABLE. Default not stated.
fields.ds_ref: HR_V3000 manual v1.2, 5 DCMODE table p.14; 5.3.1-5.3.2 p.15-16
HR_V3000 manual v1.2, 5 DCMODE table, p.14
